luck_band.note: Pool is every priced ATS side 2006-2025; a random bettor pays the full vig.

blocking_reasons: GitHub release assets (release-assets.githubusercontent.com) are unreachable from this sandbox, so nflverse player_stats (the canonical player game log release) cannot be downloaded.
No licensed historical player-prop line/price archive exists in any reachable repository, so prop ROI, hit rate and correlation values cannot be measured without fabrication.
estimator: phi between binary leg outcomes at matched thresholds (e.g. QB passing yards 275.5 and WR receiving yards 65.5)
joint hit rate vs product of marginals for every same-game pair, with week-block bootstrap CI
threshold-swept conditional probability P(leg B over | leg A over) to expose non-linear dependence
delta-method or bootstrap CI on the correlation, plus n and missingness per pair

results.note: No value is published. Blank means unverified, never zero.
